title: oscillating-autoscaler-metric-duplication-ops-log
body:
Summary:
A multi-region Dedicated GPU pool experienced persistent autoscaler oscillation over a ~6 hour window. Symptoms were repeated scale-ups followed by near-immediate scale-downs across several pools, causing transient queueing and a 2-6s median tail latency increase for short chat requests. This incident was traced to duplicated autoscaler metrics being ingested for a subset of nodes (sidecar exporter left enabled), which doubled the weight of a few tenants in the autoscaler decision logic and triggered hysteresis.

Why this is different from previous noisy-neighbor incidents:
- Not GPU firmware or thermal throttling.
- Not tenant compute spikes.
- Root cause is telemetry duplication (observability->control-plane feedback loop) leading to misinformed scale decisions.

Immediate timeline (UTC):
- 2025-02-14 02:13 - Pager alert: autoscaler_oscillation_v1 firing (ratio of scale_events > 3 in 15m).
- 02:17 - Oncall (Aisha) joins #sre-oncall, posts initial triage: "seeing repeated HPA/CA changes in us-west1-dedicated-3"
- 02:22 - Confirmed: repeated ScaleUp -> ScaleDown within 60-120s across three nodes. Observed matching CPU and queue metrics.
- 02:30 - Correlated metrics in Prometheus: metric 'dedicated_pool_running_jobs_total' reported double-count for 3 nodes.
 - 02:37 - Hypothesis: duplicate exporter process on nodes shipping duplicate time series.
- 02:44 - Executed discovery script: kubectl -n infra get pods -o wide | grep metrics-sidecar ; found a stale sidecar on nodes provisioned by a partial rollout of infra-agent v2.1.
- 02:50 - Mitigation 1: Temporarily blacklisted duplicated series in Prometheus remote_write route using relabel to drop exact series names (short term, <1h).
- 03:05 - Autoscaler oscillation rate dropped by ~85%. Median tail latency recovered to baseline.
- 04:20 - Rollback of infra-agent v2.1 partial rollout to remove the duplicate sidecar.
- 05:15 - Prometheus config reverted from blacklist; validation run confirms single series per node.
- 08:10 - Final validation completed. Incident declared mitigated.

Key diagnostic signals and queries used:
- PromQL to detect duplication: count by (instance, job) (dedicated_pool_running_jobs_total) > 1
- HPA/CA events: kubectl get hpa --all-namespaces -o json | jq '.items[] | {name:.metadata.name, events:.status.conditions}'
- Event log: gcloud logging read "resource.type=container AND jsonPayload.cluster_name=dedicated-us-west1" --limit 1000

Root cause analysis (what happened):
1) A partial rollout of infra-agent v2.1 included an experimental metrics-sidecar that was supposed to be enabled only for canary nodes.
2) Due to a config templating bug, the sidecar was enabled on a subset of production nodes in cluster 'dedicated-us-west1-3'.
3) The sidecar exported the same metric names without canonical labels, producing duplicate series in Prometheus and doubling the apparent load from those nodes in the autoscaler decision layer.
4) Autoscaler logic uses an aggregated metric weighted by sum(rate(...)). The duplication pushed the metric above scale-up thresholds, then the real load dissipated, causing immediate scale-downs (oscillation).

Temporary mitigations applied (ordered):
- Blocked duplicated series in Prometheus using relabel drop rules (short-lived).
- Increased cooldown window for autoscaler evaluations to 3m in the control plane as a circuit-breaker (reduce repeated flip-flop while root cause addressed).
- Rolled back infra-agent v2.1 partial canary to last-known-good v2.0 on affected node pool.

Permanent remediations and action items (owners and ETA):
- INFRA-939: Add metric deduplication/validity checks in the telemetry ingestion path (owner: Miguel Santos, ETA: 2025-03-07).
- INFRA-940: Fix templating bug that enabled sidecar on non-canary nodes; add unit test preventing identical label sets across exporters (owner: Evelyn Cho, ETA: 2025-02-28).
- SRE-DR-21: Harden autoscaler to ignore unusually correlated duplication spikes by validating per-instance series cardinality before final decision (owner: Ravi Menon, ETA: 2025-03-14).
- RUNBOOK-UPDATE: Add a short checklist for "suspected metric duplication" with PromQL snippets and mitigation commands (owner: Aisha Patel, ETA: 2025-02-20).

Runbook snippet (to be added to SRE playbooks):
1) Detect duplication:
   - promql: count(dedicated_pool_running_jobs_total) by (instance, job) > 1
   - If true for >5% of nodes in a pool, consider metric duplication.
2) Short-term containment:
   - Add relabel drop rules in Prometheus config for specific series (example):
     - job: 'dedicated_exporter'
     - source_labels: [__name__, instance]
     - regex: 'dedicated_pool_running_jobs_total;10.0.12.3'
     - action: drop
   - Increase autoscaler evaluation cooldown: patch control plane config 
     (kubectl patch config autoscaler --patch '{"spec":{"cooldownSeconds":180}}')
3) Permanent fix path:
   - Identify offending agent rollout; rollback or patch the template; validate in canary.

Commands run (for reproducibility):
- kubectl -n infra exec -it prometheus-0 -- promtool check config /etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml
- kubectl -n infra get pods -o wide | egrep 'infra-agent|metrics-sidecar'
- kubectl -n infra logs prometheus-0 --since=1h | grep 'duplicate series' || true
- gcloud compute ssh infra-pool-node-430 --command "sudo systemctl status infra-agent"

Notes and open questions:
- Why did Prometheus accept identical series? There is a label mismatch test missing in our pushgateway/agent configuration validation.
- Does the autoscaler need a separate safeguard when telemetry cardinality changes abruptly? (SRE-DR-21)
- We observed two other transient clusters with minor duplication (1-2 nodes). Is there a rollout-wide problem or just a template edge-case?

Post-incident follow-up plan:
- 48-hour postmortem working session scheduled with infra, telemetry, and SRE (2025-02-16 16:00 UTC). Owner: Aisha Patel.
- Complete INFRA-940 and RUNBOOK-UPDATE before the next infra-agent release.
- Add an automated weekly job that validates unique series cardinality per node and alerts if >2 duplicates detected (owner: Miguel Santos).

Appendix: sample PromQL checks to add to monitoring
- Duplicate series per instance: count(dedicated_pool_running_jobs_total) by (instance) - count(count(dedicated_pool_running_jobs_total) by (instance, job)) > 0
- Autoscaler flip rate: increase(scale_events_total[15m]) > 3

Slack/comms snippets used during incident:
- "incoming: seeing rapid HPA changes in us-west1-3; checking metrics for duplication — hold scale actions until we confirm" - posted in #sre-oncall at 02:19 UTC
- "rolled back agent canary on affected nodes — should see relabel effect in 1-2min" - posted at 04:22 UTC

Document notes: keep this file as the canonical ops-log for this incident. Once remediations are merged and the runbook updated, we will publish a distilled postmortem to Confluence and link it from INFRA-939.
